concerns.text: FR-010 requires a power analysis but does not specify the effect size, variance, or alpha level used to compute statistical power, making the power calculation non‑reproducible and the conditional switch to Wilcoxon test unverifiable.

FR-001 mentions retrieving material properties from the NIST Materials Data Repository but provides an empty placeholder for the DOI/URL ("()"). Without a concrete identifier the download step cannot be verified.
